name: The Crack Shack
menu_notes: crackshack.com/menu confirms all of our section names (Sandwiches, Main Chicks, Combos, Healthy Cluck, Sides & Shares, Lil' Cluckers, Sweets) but doesn't publish prices (site says prices vary by location); the Toast ordering page (source_url) returned 403. Cross-checked 6 dish prices via web search of delivery-platform listings: every dish name matched exactly, but every price is $2-7 low versus current 2026 pricing (Firebird $14.50 vs $16.50, Coop Deville $14.50 vs $16.50, Uncle Phil-ly Cheesesteak $17 vs $19, Half Bird $20 vs $23, Whole Bird $38 vs $45). Family Flock ($60) matched the current 'Small Flock' price exactly despite the name change. Reads as the real, current menu that just hasn't had a recent price refresh.
data_notes: Address (2266 Kettner Blvd, San Diego, 92101), neighborhood (Little Italy), cuisine (American/New American), and lat/lng (32.7279, -117.1712) are all correct. Restaurant is open.
issues: Prices are stale by roughly $2-7 per item across sandwiches, bone-in chicken mains, and flock meals — needs a fresh price pull
'Family Flock' appears to have been renamed 'Small Flock' on the current menu (same $60 price, same contents)
